sentences.text: Lab Report: Text classification with neural networks
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 12 GB of memory.
The dataset was split into 80 percent training data and the rest for testing.
Figure 1 shows the test accuracy of GRU by dataset.
As shown in Figure 1, GRU scores 22.6 points higher on SST-2 than on SVHN.
GRU achieves 66.3% test accuracy on Fashion-MNIST (Figure 1).
As shown in Figure 1, GRU reaches 60.8% test accuracy on AG News.
GRU achieves 86.4% test accuracy on CIFAR-10.
Figure 2 shows the accuracy during training.
From epoch 20 to epoch 40, the accuracy of Ours improves by a relative 4.1%.
Ours attains a accuracy of 80.4% at epoch 10.
At epoch 35, Ours achieves about 90% accuracy.
Ours scores 1.6 points higher on 40 than on 25.
The differences between the models are discussed in the next section.
